remarks: Welcome to the tranquil and beautifully manicured grounds of Foxboro Court! This highly sought after complex is located on the border of Norwalk and Wilton with close proximity to restaurants and shops. This condominium is complimented with ample parking, sidewalks and open green areas for strolling and dog walking, along with a sparkling, community pool. The deck off the living room overlooks a green lawn and trees which lend to the privacy. This home offers an open floor plan for the dining and living rooms with plenty of sunlight, plus built-ins and a wood burning fireplace. The large kitchen provides an abundance of cabinets and overlooks the home's entrance. A half-bath completes the main floor. Upstairs are two bedrooms, both with full baths. The primary suite provides skylights, plenty of closet space and separate tub and shower. The lower level has additional closet space, access to the single car garage, laundry area and carpeted space for storage or a workout room. Family and friends will find it easy to visit your home to enjoy the secluded feel. This is an Estate Sale and sold As-Is.
